players.product: BUZZ HPC GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB200 / GB300 / B200 / H200 clusters in Bell AI Fabric data centers in Canada) plus HPC colocation conversions of owned sites (Boden Sweden, Toronto gigafactory)

quarterly_data.signal: HIVE's 8-K (preliminary, unaudited management estimates): on August 21, 2026 HIVE exceeded $1 million in daily revenue from the combined production of hashrate services and GPU cloud services; since then its GPU cloud operations have generated approximately $100,000 in average daily revenue. Its Swedish Bitcoin mining operations represented less than 5% of global daily revenue during August, and HIVE intends to wind down Bitcoin mining at these facilities as it evaluates repurposing the existing infrastructure toward higher-value HPC and AI applications.
quarterly_data.figure: combined daily revenue above $1 million; GPU cloud ~$100,000 average daily revenue; Swedish sites to be repurposed toward HPC / AI

quarterly_data.signal: HIVE CEO Aydin Kilic (8-K exhibit): the GPU cloud demand pipeline has grown to more than $1 billion in total contract value potential, and year to date HIVE has closed more than $600 million of total contract value for GPU cloud contracts (signed agreements and letters of intent), notably including three- and five-year agreements with creditworthy counterparties.
quarterly_data.figure: GPU cloud pipeline >$1 billion TCV potential; >$600 million TCV closed year to date
